title: Eight Winters and One Short Form
subtitle: 国际交流 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国际交流（人与社会·历史、社会与文化）
meta: 主题语境：国际交流（人与社会·历史、社会与文化）　|　核心词汇：exchange　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exchange 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 my aunt ① arranged an exchange that no headmaster in the city would have approved, and she said the arranging was the whole of the winter. The ② exchange, meaning the visit itself and not the letter, ran eight winters and stayed unapproved in the book; an exchange, she said, is the only thing in a city that is judged by how long it is left unapproved.

Every ③ exchange in that city had the same short form beside it, and the ④ exchange at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the students and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An exchange, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to approve; my aunt said the approving is the part that fills eight winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the exchange was the whole of the year, meaning the swap and not the visit. The ⑥ exchange, meaning the swap and not any of that, is the only thing in a year that everybody waits for and nobody approves; exchange, he said, is either something you arrange or the only word that means both a visit and a swap. He said the swap is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ exchange had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short form. The ⑧ exchange of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one city and eight winters of approving; exchange, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to approve. She said the approving was never mentioned.

The ⑨ exchange I remember is the one approved in the plan, which closed in 1990 and is still described as the quietest in the city. An ⑩ exchange, my mother said in 1992, is the only one that improves by being approved; every exchange, she said, is a swap that has agreed to look like a visit. She said the swap was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 交流；互访（指城里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 交流（指那次互访本身，与信件相对）
C. 固定搭配：arrange an exchange 安排一次交流
D. n. 交流（指留给学生们的那一次）
E. n. 交流（抽象总称，指一座城市的互访之事）
F. n. 交流（指方案上写到、被批准的那一次）
G. n. 交换；互换（指一年里人人都等却无人批准的那样事情）
H. n. 交换（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人批准的那样事情）

items.q: arranged an exchange that no headmaster in the city would have approved
The exchange, meaning the visit itself and not the letter
the exchange at the far side
the exchange was the whole of the year
the exchange had become a line in a plan
The exchange of the whole thing
An exchange, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: arrange an exchange 意为“安排一次交流”，1981 年姑姑安排了一次城里没有一位校长肯批准的交流。
exchange 意为“交流”，指那次互访本身而不是信件，它经过了八个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
exchange 意为“交流”，指城里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一张短短的表格。
exchange 意为“交流”，指留给学生们的那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
exchange 意为“交换、互换”，指一年里人人都等却无人批准的那样事情，叔叔说这次互换就是那一年的全部。
exchange 意为“交换”，指人人都等却无人批准的那样事情而不是那次互访，是一年里人人都等、却无人批准的东西。
exchange 意为“交流”，指方案上写到、被批准的那一次，到 1987 年这一次成了方案里的一行。
exchange 意为“交流”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的互访之事是一座城市和八个冬天的批准。
exchange 意为“交流”，我记得的是方案上批准的那一次，1990 年结束了，至今仍被说成城里最安静的一次。
exchange 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，一次交流是唯一会因为被好好批准而变得更好的东西。
